entities.summary: David Smith is an American professional volleyball player who plays as a middle blocker for Ślepsk Malow Suwałki and the U.S. national team. Smith was a bronze medalist at the Olympic Games Rio 2016, Paris 2024 and the 2018 World Championship; the 2015 World Cup winner and a three–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA.
